title: Add-On Price List, Tailwise Grooming Salon
content:
Add-ons are extra services a customer may request on a Tailwise Grooming Salon booking. The list price of each add-on depends on the pass the visit is booked on.

| Pass | Flea and tick bath | Teeth brushing | Deshedding treatment | Add-on discount for an active Tailwise Plus membership |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Express Bath Pass 3-Visit | 18.00 | 10.00 | 25.00 | 10 percent |
| Bath & Tidy Pass 4-Visit | 18.00 | 10.00 | 25.00 | 10 percent |
| Full Groom Pass 4-Visit | 18.00 | 10.00 | 25.00 | 10 percent |
| Full Groom Pass 6-Visit | 18.00 | 10.00 | 25.00 | 10 percent |
| Spa Groom Pass 6-Visit | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 10 percent |
| Groom Club Monthly | 18.00 | 10.00 | 25.00 | 10 percent |

Prices are in USD per add-on per visit. On the Spa Groom Pass 6-Visit the three add-on prices are 0.00; teeth brushing, the deshedding treatment and the flea and tick bath are also among the services that pass performs on every visit.

The add-on discount column is the percentage taken off each add-on price when the customer's Tailwise Plus membership is in status active.

**Price points (hypothetical bookings)**

| Booking | List price of the add-on | With an active Tailwise Plus membership |
|---|---|---|
| Teeth brushing on a Bath & Tidy Pass 4-Visit visit | 10.00 | 9.00 |
| Deshedding treatment on a Groom Club Monthly visit | 25.00 | 22.50 |
| Flea and tick bath on a Full Groom Pass 6-Visit visit | 18.00 | 16.20 |
| Deshedding treatment on a Spa Groom Pass 6-Visit visit | 0.00 | 0.00 |
